description: Stripe billing connector (read-only). Surfaces the user's recent invoices as `stripe:invoice` items in the local index — invoice number, status (draft/open/paid/void/uncollectible), amount due/paid + currency, customer id/name/email, the hosted invoice + PDF URLs, the subscription id, and the created / due / billing-period dates. Useful for answering billing questions ("which invoices are still open?", "what did ACME pay last month?") without leaving Nimbus. Bearer secret-key auth. The SaaS host (api.stripe.com) is fixed. Stripe timestamps are epoch seconds (converted to ms on index). Customers / charges / payment intents / disputes / subscription events and the `stripe.refund.create` write are deferred follow-ups.
author: Nimbus
